instructions: Show the registered strategies and support expanding the catalogue to dozens of diverse strategies. Comparison baselines and NGAS seasonal components are supporting records, not additional strategies.
Add new strategies through reviewed definitions and isolated evidence or runtime adapters. There is no fixed strategy-count limit; registration alone does not authorize trading.
Keep real account telemetry separate from historical research and offline paper playback.
Preserve the canonical experiment ledger, failed and blocked outcomes, frozen protocols and original evidence manifests.
This desktop application cannot authorize or submit paper or real-money orders.
